notes.title: Official Release Date!
notes.content:
Hi again!

I finally have some good news to share: [i]A Great Hunger[/i] has been approved for release (with two days to spare, no less)!

As mentioned in my previous update, it will be available for purchase on [b]17th May 12pm (BST)[/b] and comes with a fair few changes and new features which I have eluded to prior:

[list]
[*] An album/gallery where you can unlock a total of 6 unique CGs
[*] Proper ending cards for all 5 endings
[*] A new sprite for a previously 'text-only' character: The Cook
[*] 5 achievements for the aforementioned endings
[/list]
If you'd like to see the HD files of not just this new content, but the already existing character sprites; backgrounds; and CGs, then please consider checking out my [url=https://www.patreon.com/goldieclaws]Patreon[/url]! I typically schedule posts every 5 days and I'm also currently uploading artwork related to another visual novel that whilst set in a different universe, also has a high/dark fantasy setting.

Thanks for reading!
